study_identification_part.si_4_title: Cortical thickness and grey-matter volume anomaly detection in individual MRI scans: Comparison of two methods

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: The study uses the OASIS3 dataset (Open Access Series of Imaging Studies), which contains 2,643 high-resolution isotropic T1-weighted MRI scans from 1,038 participants. Scans were acquired using Siemens scanners at 1.5T (Magnetom Sonata and Avanto, 42 scans) and 3T (Biograph mMR and Magnetom Trio, 2,601 scans). The HC subset (CDR=0, non-converters) was used for normative model building, and the AD subset (CDR>=1) for clinical evaluation.
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: "The OASIS3 dataset (Open Access Series of Imaging Studies, LaMontagne et al., 2019) is publicly available at www.oasis-brains.org/ and contains NIFTI files of 2'643 high-resolution ... isotropic T1-weighted MRI scans from 1'038 participants."
